stops.note: a surname; Charles Boycott was born in 1832 at Burgh St Peter, Norfolk, where his father was rector
as land agent for Lord Erne at Lough Mask, County Mayo, Boycott was ostracised in 1880 under the Land League tactic urged by Charles Stewart Parnell; French, German and Russian soon borrowed the word

current_meaning: to refuse to deal with a person, organisation or country as a protest
